note: 8x8 PIPELINED (register-staged, TPU-MXU microarchitecture) weight-stationary systolic GEMM tile, int32 accumulator, signoff-clean Sky130 VCD power. The only combinational path between flip-flops is one 8x8 multiply + one add, so the critical path is K-INDEPENDENT (see systolic_pipe16 for the flat 8->16 proof). Honest tradeoff vs the combinational tile: FASTER Fmax + K-independent, but every PE register toggles each cycle so energy/MAC is HIGHER. This is a characterized toggle, not a strict dominator (pipelined_systolic_lock::pipelined_is_a_characterized_toggle_not_a_dominator).

vs_combinational_tile.verdict: pipelined trades ~2.3x energy/MAC + fill latency (K+N-1) + area for K-INDEPENDENT Fmax; both stay proven, characterized toggles
